cacheScope: fresh processes with existing populated shared shader and driver disk caches; pipeline owners start empty in each process
correctness: all provider lanes pass frozen output oracle, exact within-provider replay and physical hardware eligibility; candidate and baseline Doe output hashes match
regressionRule: A metric exceeds its limit if candidate/baseline exceeds 1.05 in both matched pairs (baseline-1/candidate-1 and baseline-2/candidate-2). An isolated cohort difference remains visible and does not establish a repeatable regression or gain.
scopedAcceptance: Retain only if physical correctness holds, immutable metadata stays with its exact shader owner, diagnostic repeated policy-inspection cost falls, and no declared metric has a repeatable regression. Application performance is reported independently.
materialPerformanceRule: Existing UMAP contract requires at least 1.10x over pinned W0 at selected-operation p50 and p95. Complete process, memory and opposite timing signs are reported separately; no operation gain can establish complete-application advantage.
